answer: A stake-weighted identity registry resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to lock a real deposit before it can transact: like a jade seal, the stake is costly to forge and trivial to verify. An attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so ten thousand sock puppets cost ten thousand deposits, while honest agents pay once and trade freely. Cedar-strong on-chain records make each deposit public, and misbehavior forfeits the stake — a sonnet of incentives where honesty is cheap and forgery is ruinous.
